title: Missing payment
content: For a missing payment, ask for the transaction date, amount, and payment reference. Check transaction status with the payments team. Do not promise a refund or confirm payment until verified.

title: Refund request
content: For refund requests, collect the order or transaction reference, date, and reason. Confirm eligibility against the company's actual refund policy before promising an outcome.

title: Login and password reset
content: For login problems, ask the customer to use the password reset flow and verify account ownership via approved channels. Never ask for passwords or verification codes.

title: Delivery tracking
content: For delivery problems, request the order number and tracking reference. Check the shipment status with the delivery provider before giving an ETA.

title: Card not working
content: If a card is declined or not working, verify that the customer has tried an alternative approved payment method. Never ask for full card numbers, CVV, or PIN.

title: Account verification
content: For account verification questions, direct the user to the official verification process. Never request identity documents in unapproved chat channels.

title: استفسار عن دفعة
content: إذا كانت الدفعة مفقودة، اطلب تاريخ المعاملة والمبلغ والرقم المرجعي. لا تؤكد وصول الدفعة قبل التحقق من حالتها عبر الفريق المختص.

title: مشكلة تسجيل الدخول
content: عند وجود مشكلة في تسجيل الدخول، اقترح إعادة تعيين كلمة المرور عبر القنوات الرسمية. لا تطلب كلمات المرور أو رموز التحقق من العميل.
